summary.text: Jean Anglade is a New York entrepreneur who ran as a write-in candidate for Mayor of New York City in 2025 and is running a write-in campaign for governor as an independent. No campaign website or public statements specific to the 2026 governor's race were found.

paragraphs.text: Born in New York; earned a high school diploma from Alif Muhammad Nia School; works as an entrepreneur, including with Celebs123 Auto Tags, and is also listed as affiliated with Western Governors University.
In his 2025 Ballotpedia survey, he described his first job as a caregiver, which he held for one year, and said he was pursuing a degree at Western Governors University.

Ran as an independent write-in candidate in the 2025 general election for Mayor of New York City, which was won by Zohran Mamdani; Ballotpedia lists him with 3 votes. In his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey during that campaign, he described himself as focused on lowering the cost of living, police accountability, and affordable housing.
